note: Written 22 Nov 2026 in the ltg-review checkout. The search a reader runs is 'best streets in London', 'prettiest streets in London' and 'famous streets in London'; those three queries return three different kinds of list (pretty residential mews, shopping streets, landmark roads), and the ranking is the overlap. The pretty-street lists are the most numerous, so mews and crescents rank high on citation count; the article says so rather than hiding it. Scope rule: a street, mews, crescent, lane or yard a visitor can walk. Areas (Mayfair, Shoreditch, Covent Garden), markets as institutions (Camden Market, Borough) and single shops are left out. Leadenhall Market stays because it is a covered street. Streets that are private roads or gated (Downing Street) stay but are described as what you can and cannot do.

knownGaps: Time Out's own London streets lists (a prettiest-streets piece and a shopping-streets guide) could not be found; every guessed slug 404ed and the engines surfaced only the Coolest Streets pieces. Retry by navigating timeout.com/london/things-to-do and /shopping archives.

Londonist, Evening Standard and Culture Trip have no street ranking that could be found; Londonist is on the permanent 403 list in data/sources.json, the Culture Trip is on the excluded list, and the Standard's only relevant piece (20 Nov 2025) reports the American Express/GlobalData ranking of independent high streets, which is syndication.
Reddit (r/london 'most beautiful street in your...' kp60xp and 'best scenic streets in London for a walk' 1d3yjis) cannot be read here. Rob to supply any thread by hand.
TikTok creators: TikTok search is not reachable by curl. Three YouTube creators recorded; Travel the Smart Way's '15 prettiest streets' video could not be read (no description, captions blocked).
Kensington Church Street is named by none of the sources collected (the only list that names it, London Perfect's, is a holiday-rental agency's blog and is declined).
Exmouth Market, Upper Street and Charlotte Street each have one source. A food-street source (Harden's or the Infatuation's 'best streets for restaurants' style lists) was not found.
openVenueQuestions: Neal's Yard and Seven Dials are merged under Neal's Yard where a source names the district (LDN Fashion, Love and London). Without that merge Neal's Yard has 11 sources rather than 13.
Hillgate Place, Hillgate Street and Hillgate Village are kept as three names; they may be one village, and merging would put it at 5.
Portobello Road is the street; Portobello Road Market is the same road and is not split.
declined: See data/consensus/streets.json 'declined': Wondrous Wandering (clickbait), tour operators and aggregators on the excluded list, London Perfect (rental agency), From One Girl to One World (thin), Travel the Smart Way (unreadable).
